limits: Exact byte values preserve empty strings, NUL, duplicate occurrences, order and updated timestamps. No Unicode/numeric normalization. Histograms/dictionaries summarize redundancy; they do not replace the original ordered payload.

Length<=15 is SSO eligibility for this GCC13/libstdc++ ABI, not live-engine capacity measurement. The observed compact model40byte object already includes32byte std::string storage even when text is short.

12byte schemaID/valueID/updated arithmetic is an uncompiled hypothetical object capacity, not an engine layout, measured peak, RSS saving or CPU speedup. Dictionary/search/refcount/decode overhead is unknown.
Current AIT1 writer already stores changed rows, not every game tick. Most positional value/update pairs remain unchanged, but update-only timestamps and schema shifts must be represented exactly.

Interning/deltas must reconstruct exactly the existing completeAIT1 payload and its original until/truncated state. Lower internal memory must not silently extend recorded history or change limits/file acceptance.

Future qualification would require current game trace, exact fullreplay AIT1/order bytes, seek/application, save/load continuation, malformed-input budgets, and affectedplatforms. No model/engine/build/profiler children launched.
